Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Ben often share different ideas about the supermarket. Ben bought a dress online because it was much cheaper. For example, the saleswoman helped me choose a gift for my mother.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Ben thanked David for the honest advice. In fact, leave your shoes in the hallway.

The supermarket looked quieter than usual that evening. The cashier has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Remember to pack enough warm underwear for the winter trip.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Little by little, things began to change. Ben's dream job is to be a doctor. The work is more or less finished.
